verdict.rationale: Steel documents built-in Managed Residential Proxies plus Bring Your Own Proxy under a dedicated stealth/proxies section that also covers proxy rotation, and lists Dedicated IPs as a session option. Its top-level docs and llms.txt claim stealth as a core feature, and a community comment corroborates the custom-proxy option. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of stealth fingerprinting controls (what is spoofed and how to enable it), explicit geo-targeting/country selection for proxies, and independent hands-on evidence that sessions avoid bot detection.
